### Thank You, Grandpa
Author: Dr. James Dobson
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-devotions-for-parents-by-dr-james-dobson/dr-dobsons-parenting-devotional-dec-8.html
Passage: Leviticus 19:32
Points:
- Modern culture increasingly tolerates coarse, disrespectful attitudes toward other people.
- Parents must deliberately teach children basic courtesy and verbal deference toward their elders.
- God's law commands believers to rise in the presence of the aged and treat them with honor.
- Cultivating honor for earthly elders lays the foundation for revering our heavenly Father.
- Instilling mutual respect during early childhood prepares families to weather later rebellion.

### How to Live an Invitation
Author: Amy Carroll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/how-to-live-an-invitation-encouragement-for-today-august-27-2014.html
Passage: Leviticus 19:34
Points:
- Entering an unfamiliar environment reminds believers how awkward and vulnerable outsiders feel.
- Once people become established insiders, they easily forget the anxieties that newcomers experience.
- God commands His followers to love the stranger as native-born, remembering their own displacement in Egypt.
- Faithful community involves holding onto established friends while keeping an open hand to welcome newcomers.
- Small gestures of personal hospitality help draw isolated people into meaningful fellowship.

### Honor an Old Face: The Lost Art of Respecting Our Elders
Author: Greg Morse
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/honor-an-old-face
Passage: Leviticus 19:32
Points:
- Contemporary society prioritizes youthful novelty, efficiency, and cosmetic appeal while marginalizing the elderly.
- God's law instructs believers to rise up before gray hair and actively honor the aged.
- Senior saints provide irreplaceable living testimonies of God's steadfast kindness and lifelong faithfulness.
- Demonstrating deferential manners toward older generations is intimately tied to the fear of God.
- Believers must resist cultural ageism and celebrate older saints in families and churches.

### Not Wired for This World: Making a Home for Special Needs
Author: Kathryn Butler
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/not-wired-for-this-world
Passage: Leviticus 19:34
Points:
- God called Israel to care tenderly for the vulnerable foreigner residing within their communities.
- Children facing severe sensory or neurodevelopmental challenges frequently experience the ordinary world as foreign territory.
- Routine church routines can easily trigger overwhelming panic in children with invisible disabilities.
- Obeying God's command to love the sojourner means extending patient empathy rather than criticism to struggling families.
- Offering a safe welcome to those who feel out of place reflects Christ's perfect love.
